test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Pandit Ananda Gopal Bandopadhyay was a _________ player of the Banaras gharana.
solution:
The correct answer is __**tabla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Ananda Gopal Bandopadhyay **was a **tabla player of the Banaras gharana**. 

 
 
• **Indian tabla player Ananda Gopal Bandopadhyay** lived from April 28, 1942, to May 7, 2021.
 
• His instructor **Mahadev Prasad Mishra** instructed him in the** Banaras Gharana style**.
 
• **Radha Gopal Bandopadhyay**, his **father**, was an amateur singer.
 
• Bandopadhyay has **performed and recorded **alone as well as partnered with a number of **well-known vocalists**.
 
• He was a former professor at the** ITC Sangeet Research Academy in Kolkata **and a well-regarded performer for both **Doordarshan and All India Radio**.
 
• He received the** President's gold medal for taking first place in the All India Radio music competition in 1965.**
 
• He also received a **gold medal from the Ethiopian Emperor in 1970**, an award rarely bestowed upon foreigners.
 
• He received the **Sangeet Ratna Award from The Salt Lake Music Association in 2012**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Along with performing in India, he has also appeared in **Boston, New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and Berlin's World Youth Festival**.
 
• **Banaras Gharana **
 
 
• **Pandit Ram Sahai** created the** Banaras tabla gharana** a little more than 200 years ago.
 
• It is one of the **six most popular ways to play the Indian tabla**.
 
• He went into **solitude for six months during which he worked to create the Benares baj**, or style, of playing the tabla.
 
• This new tabla playing technique was developed with the idea that it would be** adaptable enough to perform both solo and to accompany any style of music or dance**.
